# Copilot instructions

Flutter personal-finance app (Android/iOS, Linux desktop, web). Full architecture
notes: [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md). Shared agent entry point: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Path-scoped rules live in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` and attach
automatically by file glob. Detailed task procedures live in
`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` — **read the matching skill file before starting
one of these tasks**, they record gotchas not visible from the code:

| Task | Skill file |
|---|---|
| New feature end-to-end | `.claude/skills/flutter-new-feature/SKILL.md` |
| Any HTTP call | `.claude/skills/flutter-call-backend-endpoint/SKILL.md` |
| Caching / stale data | `.claude/skills/flutter-add-cached-data/SKILL.md` |
| Routes, deep links | `.claude/skills/flutter-add-route/SKILL.md` |
| User-facing text | `.claude/skills/flutter-add-locale-string/SKILL.md` |
| Desktop layout variant | `.claude/skills/flutter-mobile-desktop-variant/SKILL.md` |
| Colors, themes | `.claude/skills/flutter-theme-and-styling/SKILL.md` |
| Tests | `.claude/skills/flutter-write-widget-test/SKILL.md` |
| Release builds | `.claude/skills/flutter-release-build/SKILL.md` |

## Non-negotiables

1. Never hand-edit `lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart` — generated by
   `flutter gen-l10n`. Edit the `.arb` files and regenerate.
2. Never add `@injectable` / `@Injectable()`. DI codegen is **not** wired up
   despite the dependency; everything is registered by hand in `lib/main.dart`.
3. Views call repositories, never services directly.
4. Match the file-naming convention of the folder you are editing — this repo
   mixes `kebab-case.dart`, `dot.separated.dart`, and `snake_case.dart`.
5. Mobile and desktop full screens are separate widget trees selected in
   `lib/routing.dart`, not one responsive widget with breakpoints.

## Verification

```bash
flutter analyze && flutter test
```
